title: Homology-level ideal connecting map with explicit cycle formula
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, $M$ an $R$-module, and $P$ a projective resolution of $M$ whose terms are free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Write $C=P\otimes_R R/I$. There exists an $R$-linear map $\delta_H:H_1(C)\to I\otimes_R M$ such that for every degree-one cycle $z$, every $y\in P_1$ with $z=y\otimes1$, and every finite expression $d_1y=\sum_j a_jp_j$ with $a_j\in I$, $p_j\in P_0$, one has $\delta_H([z])=\sum_j a_j\otimes\epsilon(p_j)$. No assertion of injectivity or image is made here.

proof.text: Tensor the ideal inclusion and quotient map with P₀ and P₁. Freeness of P₀ implies projectivity and flatness, so Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap makes the degree-zero ideal-tensor map injective. The root lTensor_exact and LinearMap.lTensor_surjective give exactness and quotient-tensor surjectivity in the needed degrees, without flatness of P₁.

proof.text: The proved private helper cycleMap_of_exact chooses a tensor lift of each quotient cycle and its ideal-tensor differential preimage. Exactness in degree one and injectivity in degree zero show that two choices differ by an ideal-tensor differential, which the augmentation kills. Comparing lifts of sums and scalar multiples gives linearity. For a lift y tensor 1 with d y = sum a_j p_j, choose sum p_j tensor a_j as the preimage; tensor symmetry and augmentation give the required formula. To kill boundaries, use tensor induction in degree two, lift a quotient coefficient to r in R, and apply the formula with y = r times d₂p and the empty sum. Descend using HomologicalComplex.homologyIsCokernel and its π_desc identity.

theorem exists_tor_ideal_homology_formula
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (hP : ∀ n : ℕ, Module.Free R (P.complex.X n))
    :
    ∃ δH : ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).homology 1 →ₗ[R] (I ⊗[R] M),
      (∀ (z : ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸
        I))).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).cycles 1)
        (y : P.complex.X 1) (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → I) (p : Fin k → P.complex.X 0),
        ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).iCycles 1 z = y ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R ⧸ I) →
        P.complex.d 1 0 y = ∑ j, (a j : R) • p j →
        δH
          (((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).homologyπ 1 z) =
          ∑ j, a j ⊗ₜ[R] P.π.f 0 (p j))
